build.comment: Override the default build so Nixpacks does NOT run `npm run build` (the Angular SSR build) — the API runs server/src directly via the SWC loader, so the only build step is generating the Prisma client. Use `npm install` (not `npm ci`): npm < 10 fails to resolve rollup's nested cross-platform optional deps from the lock and aborts; `npm install` reconciles instead. --include=dev keeps the `prisma` CLI (a devDependency) available for generate.
